Just now

Nobody has ever quit a job over a bad folder structure. Plenty of developers have quietly grown to dread opening a project because of one.
I inherited a codebase once where finding a single component meant checking four different folders, none of which had an obvious reason to exist. Nothing was technically wrong. The app ran fine. Onboarding a new hire onto it took two full weeks longer than it should have, and nobody could say exactly why, because the damage was structural, not visible in any one file.
Ten mistakes. None of them will show up in a code review as a bug. All ten will show up, eventually, as the reason your team moves slower than it should.
Mistake 1: Organizing by File Type Instead of Feature
The problem
src/app/
components/
order-list.component.ts
user-profile.component.ts
cart-summary.component.ts
services/
order.service.ts
user.service.ts
cart.service.ts
pipes/
order-status.pipe.tsEverything related to orders is scattered across three unrelated folders, sitting next to code for completely different features that happen to share the same file type.
